name: Postmark
label: Postmark — Postmark API
description: Postmark via the official Postmark API. Base https://api.postmarkapp.com. Docs: https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/email-api. Transactional only. Handler: OfficialApiNode. OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data}. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Postmark operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"send-email"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-email | send-template | send-batch | get-bounce | list-bounces | listen. list-bounces requires count and offset query params (defaults 50 and 0 when omitted). listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: send-email.

schema.label: From
schema.description: Sender (must be a Postmark Sender Signature). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: To
schema.description: Recipient(s). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: Subject
schema.description: Subject for send-email. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: HtmlBody
schema.description: HTML body. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: TextBody
schema.description: Text body. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: TemplateId
schema.description: Template id for send-template. Official: TemplateId OR TemplateAlias (https://postmarkapp.com/developer/api/templates-api). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Bounce id for get-bounce (path). Aliases: bounceID, bounce_id. Purpose: operation input.

schema.label: bounceID
schema.description: Same as id for get-bounce. Postmark API name. Purpose: operation input.

schema.label: Cc
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Cc` for operation: send-email.

schema.label: Bcc
schema.description: Request-body parameter `Bcc` for operation: send-email.

schema.label: ReplyTo
schema.description: Request-body parameter `ReplyTo` for operation: send-email.

schema.label: Tag
schema.description: Message tag: body `Tag` for send-email / send-template, or list-bounces filter (query `tag`). Example: welcome.

schema.label: Attachments
schema.description: send-email / send-template attachments [{Name, Content, ContentType, ContentID}]. Content is base64. Never log. Example: [{"Name":"a.pdf","ContentType":"application/pdf","Content":"..."}].

schema.label: MessageStream
schema.description: Message stream ID: body for send-email / send-template, or list-bounces filter (query `messagestream`). Default outbound. Example: outbound.

schema.label: TrackOpens
schema.description: send-email. true tracks opens. Example: true.

schema.label: TrackLinks
schema.description: send-email. EXACT: None | HtmlAndText | HtmlOnly | TextOnly. Example: HtmlAndText.

schema.label: Metadata
schema.description: send-email / send-template metadata map. Example: {"order":"1001"}.

schema.label: Headers
schema.description: send-email custom headers [{Name, Value}].

schema.label: TemplateAlias
schema.description: Request-body parameter `TemplateAlias` for operation: send-template.

schema.label: TemplateModel
schema.description: Template variable values for send-template (required by the API; the node sends {} when omitted). Example: {"name":"Ana","product":"Acme"}.

schema.label: Messages
schema.description: JSON array (1–500 items) for send-batch — sent as the root POST body. Alias: messages. Required by: send-batch.

schema.label: count
schema.description: Page size for list-bounces (max 500). Required on the wire; default 50 when omitted.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: Number of bounces to skip for list-bounces (required on the wire; the node sends 0 when omitted; count + offset ≤ 10,000). Example: 0.

schema.label: type
schema.description: list-bounces filter by bounce type. Example: HardBounce.

schema.label: inactive
schema.description: list-bounces filter: true = only addresses Postmark deactivated, false = only active; omit for both. Example: true.

schema.label: email_filter
schema.description: list-bounces filter by recipient email address (query `emailFilter`). Example: ada@example.com.

schema.label: message_id
schema.description: list-bounces filter by message ID (query `messageID`). Example: 2c1b63fe-43f2-4db5-91b0-8bdfa44a9316.

schema.label: from_date
schema.description: list-bounces start of range, inclusive, Eastern Time (query `fromdate`). Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. Example: 2026-01-01T00:00:00.

schema.label: to_date
schema.description: list-bounces end of range, inclusive, Eastern Time (query `todate`). Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. Example: 2026-01-31T23:59:59.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-email, send-template, send-batch, get-bounce, list-bounces, listen. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: Server token
configurationParameters.description: Postmark Server API token. Header X-Postmark-Server-Token. StudioQuack secret. Account token is not used here. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
